description:
Manager – Human Resources

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Experience: 10–15 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent

Industry: PEB / Prefabricated Construction / Manufacturing / Engineering / Project-Based Business

Work Mode: On-site

Compensation: ₹10–12 LPA, depending on experience, capability and fit

About the Role

We are hiring a Manager – Human Resources for a growing organization operating across its corporate office, factory and multiple project sites.

This is a hands-on HR leadership role for an experienced HR professional who can independently manage the HR function, take people-related decisions, advise senior management and build practical HR systems and processes.

The role will work closely with the CEO and business/function heads and will have ownership across the employee lifecycle — from manpower planning and recruitment to performance management, employee relations, retention and HR systems.

This is not a recruitment-only or HR administration role.

Key Responsibilities

HR Strategy & Manpower Planning

* Drive HR planning in line with business and manpower requirements.
* Work with the CEO and business heads on organization structure, manpower requirements and people-related decisions.
* Identify workforce gaps and recommend appropriate solutions.

Management Advisory & Decision-Making

* Act as the HR advisor to the CEO and senior management.
* Independently handle routine employee-related decisions within company policies.
* Advise management on employee performance, grievances, disciplinary matters, retention, promotions, increments and role changes.
* Handle sensitive and difficult employee situations with maturity, fairness and confidentiality.

Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

* Lead recruitment across corporate, factory and project/site requirements.
* Manage critical and senior-level hiring.
* Strengthen selection, onboarding and induction processes.

Performance Management

* Drive KRA/KPI frameworks, performance reviews, probation and confirmation processes.
* Manage PIP and performance-related interventions.
* Ensure accountability and performance discipline across teams.

Employee Relations & Retention

* Handle employee grievances, conflicts and disciplinary matters.
* Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Maintain a healthy balance between employee concerns and business requirements.

HR Policies, Processes & Systems

* Build, implement and improve HR policies, SOPs and processes.
* Strengthen employee lifecycle processes from onboarding to exit.
* Ensure consistency of HR practices across office, factory and project locations.

HR MIS & Reporting

* Prepare and maintain HR MIS and management dashboards.
* Track manpower, attrition, hiring, performance and other key HR metrics.
* Provide meaningful HR insights to management.

Factory & Project-Site HR

* Regularly interact with factory and project sites.
* Support manpower planning, employee relations and HR processes at operational locations.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies across locations.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an HR professional with:

* **10–15 years of progressive HR Generalist / HR Leadership experience**
* Demonstrated experience in 
  **independent HR decision-making**
* Experience advising 
  **CEO / promoters / business heads**
* Strong exposure to manpower planning, recruitment, performance management, employee relations and retention
* Experience handling grievances, disciplinary matters and difficult employee situations
* Hands-on experience with 
  **KRA/KPI, appraisal, probation, confirmation and PIP**
* Experience across 
  **corporate office + factory/plant/project/site environments**
* Strong HR MIS and reporting capabilities
* Good understanding of HR policies and applicable labour/statutory requirements
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have as a HR Generalist/HR Manager, with responsibility beyond recruitment and HR administration?
* Have you personally built, implemented or significantly improved HR processes/systems in your current or previous organization?
* Do you have hands-on experience do you have with KRA/KPI setting, performance reviews, probation/confirmation and PIPs?
* In your current role, whom did you report to directly?
* Have you personally managed blue-collar factory workers or contract labour in a manufacturing/industrial setup?

The organization manages the entire travel journey, from concept and planning to execution and post-trip support, ensuring comfortable and hassle-free service. * Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar HR leadership role, preferably in the travel, hospitality, or service industry.

**Business Head – Founder's Office** 




 Vikas Medical Devices• Kolkata •Full\-Time, On\-Site
 



 We are hiring for one of the most important roles at Vikas Medical Devices: Business Head \- Founding Partner. This is a high\-exposure, high\-accountability position for someone who wants to learn how a business is actually run – and take ownership of running it. You will work directly alongside the Founding Partner, take over the responsibilities he manages day\-to\-day, and act as his proxy across the organisation. This is not a notes\-and\-calendar role; it is about operating at the highest level of the company, driving execution, and ensuring nothing of importance is allowed to drift.
 



**Role Overview** 




 You will progressively take over the functions the Founding Partner handles personally and own them end\-to\-end – across finance, operations, supply chain, sales and administration. You will be close to the decisions, conversations and priorities that shape the direction of the company, and you will be expected to think and act like an owner.
 



**Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities** 



* Act as the Founding Partner’s proxy and manage the priorities he handles each day.
* Communicate and follow up with stakeholders on commitments and open issues.
* Coordinate internally with senior management and department heads on action points and deliverables.
* Collect, review and consolidate daily reporting from senior management.
* Identify, resolve or escalate finance\-related issues – payments, collections and cost control.
* Handle departmental queries and unblock teams so work keeps moving.
* Track all active projects and ensure they are completed on time.
* Schedule and run review meetings as required, and hold teams accountable to outcomes.
* Build and maintain dashboards and MIS that the business can actually decide on.
* Drive hard, persistent follow\-up – internal and external – until matters are closed.



 In short, anything and everything an entrepreneur would do to keep the business running and moving forward.
 



**What You Will Gain** 



* A real understanding of how a fast\-moving healthcare business operates across sales, service, operations and leadership.
* Direct insight into how critical decisions are made across customers, principals, teams and markets.
* Hands\-on experience driving execution when everything appears important.
* Exposure to how strategy moves from discussion to action.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* 3–5 years in strategy, business analytics, founder’s office, CEO office, consulting, operations or a similar role.
* Strong command of Excel, AI and structured thinking.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Analytical, disciplined and comfortable in a high\-accountability environment.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong follow\-up and ownership.
* Healthcare, distribution or manufacturing experience preferred but not mandatory – attitude and capability matter more than background.

**Cafeteria Management**

* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor.

**Team Management**

* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.

* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.


**Projects and Transitions**

description:
**Position Summary** 




 The City Director (CD) plays a critical role in unleashing the potential and power of a local movement for educational equity in this metropolis. This individual creates and shapes a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context and develops a long\-term strategy that will fully realise the regional vision. The City Director, therefore, has a five\-fold charge:
 


1. Ensuring that Teach For India Fellows are not only driving transformational outcomes for children in classrooms, but that they’re growing as leaders.
2. Fostering a local, growing Alumni movement that is committed to providing all children an excellent education.
3. Building a local, enduring institution that promotes sustainable funding, talent, and operations – including assembling effective teams and resources, coaching talent to outcomes and leading the site rooted in strong culture
4. Serving as a critical organisational leader for operations that span Teach For India’s vision and mission.
5. Co\-creating the strategy \& roadmap to serve 1 in 10 children from low income communities in the city.



 To achieve that five\-fold charge, the CD works closely with the local program team to create an ecosystem of support for Fellows that enables them to be successful in their roles as teachers and future leaders of the movement. The CD also works to foster a sense of community among Alumni in the city and mobilises them towards shared goals, while also building partnerships with a range of government, corporate, and civil society players to catalyse systemic impact and ensure the long\-term sustainability of our efforts. Last but not least, the CD plays an integral role in building the capability and commitment of members of the City Operations team to contribute to our mission in the long\-term.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Envision, develop and update a contextualized vision for Teach For India’s operations in the city:** 



* Articulate a vision for the city that is rooted in the local context, yet directly aligned to Teach For India's larger national movement
* Phase out the city vision into a short\-mid\-and long term roadmap, with clearly defined goals and measures for success
* Build investment and ownership among Staff, Fellows, Alumni, \& Partners in the vision and goals.



**2\. Develop a strategic and operational plan that is designed to realise the vision:** 



* Design a strategic plan that effectively sets priorities, searches for innovative paths and best practices, and accounts for regional uncertainties and externalities.
* Design short\-term tactical plans to mobilise resources and guide a team to outcomes in the short\-and\-mid term



**3\. Manage the Executive Team in the city:** 



* Establish and/or strengthen infrastructure needed to maximize performance and operations of both talent and resources (processes, structure, systems, communication)
* Select, mentor and develop a group of your direct reports (managees) that is composed of the right skills, knowledge, and mindsets needed to advance transformational progress for children through the City roadmap.
* Build a systematic approach to people development to ensure that team members across the site are growing, performing and flourishing
* Establish clear accountability, decision making responsibilities, and performance expectations that are aligned to the strategic plan



**4\. Build relationships with key partners and stakeholders to foster collective impact and ensure long\-term sustainability:** 



* Build the site into a sustainable organisation rooted in local funding and talent
* Develop the operational infrastructure to enable scale and efficiency
* Engage with local networks, Alumni, education sector stakeholders to make Teach For India a strong voice in regional communities of practice
* Build, engage and strengthen a strong advisory board
* Play a front\-facing role in local fundraising efforts and capacities



**5\. Manage a growing team towards short\-term outcomes and long\-term success:** 



* Manage city vertical leads that span Program, Partnerships (Alumni \& Government) and People (Recruitment, HR, Job Placements, etc.)
* Design systems and processes to manage progress and people across layers
* Build and execute a strong performance management plan to ensure progress



**6\. Establish and uphold a strong culture of inspiration, honesty, support, and accountability among team members:** 



* Foster an internal team culture that is rooted in our organisational values.
* Model culture both internally and externally.
* Build on\-going relationships with our internal community



**7\. Collaborate with teams across clusters at Teach For India (People, Impact \& Operations, Movement Building, Regions, Office of the Senior Leadership team).** 




  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




**As a member of the Leadership team:** 



* Providing feedback on organisational decision\-making and long\-term strategy as a member of the Leadership Team.
* Driving internal alignment and support for Teach For India’s core Programs.
* Serving as an ambassador of the Teach For India brand and an advocate for our work and for educational equity in our country through both internal and external communication.
* Supporting key organisational areas such as Recruitment, Selection, Fundraising, Movement Building, and Alumni Engagement.
* Over time, supporting Teach For India’s Alumni and other external organisations in their journey to our vision with organisational insights.



  





**Minimum Qualifications, Experiences and Expectations** 



* A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in any field with 8\+ years of relevant work experience
* Previous experience managing large projects and teams to successful outcomes
* Previous teaching/education experience would be an added advantage
* Strategic and critical thinking skills so as to conceptualise multiple approaches to solving a problem and draw out a clear roadmap with roles and responsibilities
* Relationship\-building and networking skills so as to connect individuals, groups, and partners with shared goals
* Influencing and persuasion skills so as to leverage people and relationships to outcomes
* Communication skills so as to deliver a compelling message through oral and written mediums to diverse stakeholders
* People management skills so as to manage diverse teams to outcomes
* Ability to be resourceful and entrepreneurial in the face of uncertainty
* Proficiency in analysing data and making inferences to drive strategies and decisions
* Understanding of Teach For India’s short\-term and long\-term theory of change
* Understanding of Teach For India’s leadership development philosophy and framework
